name: blake_dog-root
description: Monorepo root: shared tooling and CI/CD orchestration for blake_dog.

scripts.dev: start cmd /k "cd ./backend && pnpm dev" && start cmd /k "cd ./frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir frontend install && pnpm --dir backend install
scripts.format: pnpm --dir frontend format && pnpm --dir backend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir frontend exec prettier --check . && pnpm --dir backend exec prettier --check .
